title: Create editor shell connected to processor
description:
Create the minimal resizable ShredSpace editor in Source/PluginEditor.h and Source/PluginEditor.cpp, and connect the processor to it.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h and Source/PluginProcessor.cpp created by task a.1, specifically the class name ShredSpaceAudioProcessor and the createEditor()/hasEditor() implementations.
- ./JUCE/modules/juce_audio_processors/processors/juce_AudioProcessorEditor.h for the AudioProcessorEditor constructor and setResizable/setResizeLimits signatures.

Implement exactly:
1. class ShredSpaceAudioProcessorEditor : public juce::AudioProcessorEditor in Source/PluginEditor.h, with an explicit constructor taking ShredSpaceAudioProcessor& and a destructor, plus paint(juce::Graphics&) and resized() overrides, and JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR(ShredSpaceAudioProcessorEditor).
2. Hold the processor by reference in a private member named audioProcessor (type ShredSpaceAudioProcessor&). Do not copy or own the processor.
3. In the constructor: call setResizable (true, true), setResizeLimits (600, 400, 2400, 1600), and setSize (900, 600).
4. paint() fills the whole bounds with getLookAndFeel().findColour (juce::ResizableWindow::backgroundColourId), then draws the single centred text "ShredSpace" using juce::Justification::centred. No artist names, no song names, no vendor tagline beyond the product name.
5. resized() is present and empty (no child components exist yet).
6. In Source/PluginProcessor.cpp, replace the a.1 placeholder so that `#include "PluginEditor.h"` is present and createEditor() returns `new ShredSpaceAudioProcessorEditor (*this)`. This is the ONLY change permitted to Source/PluginProcessor.cpp in this task: do not alter isBusesLayoutSupported, processBlock, prepareToPlay, releaseResources, or any other member.

No DSP, no parameter attachments, no sliders, no timers, no image or font resources in this task.
acceptance_criteria: Source/PluginEditor.h declares ShredSpaceAudioProcessorEditor deriving from juce::AudioProcessorEditor with a constructor taking ShredSpaceAudioProcessor&
Source/PluginEditor.cpp constructor calls setResizable(true, true), setResizeLimits(600, 400, 2400, 1600), and setSize(900, 600)
Source/PluginEditor.cpp paint() draws the centred text "ShredSpace" and contains no artist or song names
Source/PluginProcessor.cpp includes "PluginEditor.h" and createEditor() returns new ShredSpaceAudioProcessorEditor (*this)
Source/PluginProcessor.cpp isBusesLayoutSupported and processBlock bodies are unchanged from task a.1
Only Source/PluginEditor.h, Source/PluginEditor.cpp, and Source/PluginProcessor.cpp are created or modified by this task
forbidden_changes: create or modify any file under JUCE/
modify any part of Source/PluginProcessor.cpp other than adding the PluginEditor.h include and the createEditor() return statement
create or modify CMakeLists.txt or CMakePresets.json
create or modify scripts/build_all.sh, .gitignore, or anything under docs/
add sliders, buttons, parameter attachments, timers, or custom LookAndFeel classes
add binary resources, images, or fonts
include artist or song names in any string

allowed: choose the font size and colour used for the centred "ShredSpace" text
choose include order and include guard style
forbidden: introduce child components or parameter attachments
introduce a custom LookAndFeel or resource binary
change the processor class name or its bus layout contract
